author: BartucsCutThroat
body:
Tanky area pvp defense with a pet who can wake you up.  Although people have a lot more tools to do damage, making someone spend a lot of time fighting you can be a defense in itself.  

Honestly haven't seen this in use for 4 years or so. There's better tools that don't gimp you as hard, or are more versatile.
